autoTower.recommendationIntro: These are recommendations for regular use; review them before saving.

commander_assignment.label: Commander assignment
commander_assignment.description: In Commanders, allow Auto Towers for the commanders you want to use and select Save assignments.

general.title: Set scanning, daily limits and travel

open_settings.label: Open settings
open_settings.description: Open Automation, then select the settings button on the Auto Towers card.

authoritative_map_scan_every.label: Authoritative map scan · Every
authoritative_map_scan_every.description: Choose how often to refresh each castle’s tower list, from 1,800–3,600 seconds; attacks can launch between scans.

daily_normal_attack_limit.label: Daily normal-attack limit
daily_normal_attack_limit.description: Pauses at your account-wide daily attack limit until the game resets it; 0 removes the limit.

horse_travel_boost.label: Horse travel boost
horse_travel_boost.description: Uses your selected travel option for each attack, including every hit in an Advisor chain, with speed based on the source castle’s travel buildings.
horse_travel_boost.recommendation: Coin tier where supported, with enough coins.

travel_feather.label: Travel feather
travel_feather.description: Uses the travel feather option rather than a coin or ruby horse tier.

horse_ship_tier_coins.label: Horse / ship tier · coins
horse_ship_tier_coins.description: Spends coins on the coin travel tier.

warhorse_fast_ship_tier_rubies.label: Warhorse / fast ship tier · rubies
warhorse_fast_ship_tier_rubies.description: Spends rubies on the first ruby travel tier when selected.

courser_fastest_ship_tier_rubies.label: Courser / fastest ship tier · rubies
courser_fastest_ship_tier_rubies.description: Spends rubies on the faster ruby travel tier when selected.

image.alt: Auto Towers general settings with fictional Synthetic Castle data
image.caption: Set the scan interval, daily attack limit and travel option; Advisor controls appear when available.

castle_switch.label: Castle switch
castle_switch.description: Turn on each castle you want Auto Towers to scan and attack from.
castle_switch.recommendation: Enable the castles you want to use regularly.

radius.label: Radius
radius.description: Choose how far to search around this castle, from 1–50 tiles.

choose_troop.label: Choose troop
choose_troop.description: Choose the stationed troop to fill both attack flanks; attacks wait if there are too few.
choose_troop.recommendation: A stationed attack troop with enough units for both flanks.

maiden_supported_only.label: Maiden-supported only
maiden_supported_only.description: Limits this castle to available commanders with the supported maiden relic.
maiden_supported_only.recommendation: Off unless your chosen commander has the supported maiden relic.

image.alt: Auto Towers castle settings with fictional Synthetic Castle data
image.caption: Enable a castle and choose its radius, troop and maiden requirement.

advisor.title: Use Advisor if wanted · when available

use_advisor_with_time_skips.label: Use Advisor with Time Skips
use_advisor_with_time_skips.description: Repeats hits on one tower, using one daily attack first and one Time Skip of at least three hours per extra hit.

auto_activate_with_token.label: Auto-activate with token
auto_activate_with_token.description: Uses an available Baron Advisor token when the Advisor is inactive, without buying a token or spending rubies.

maximum_daily_time_skips.label: Maximum daily Time Skips
maximum_daily_time_skips.description: Caps Time Skips used by confirmed Advisor chains until the game’s daily attack counter resets; 0 pauses Advisor launches.

finish.title: Set the schedule, save and switch on

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.description: Use Calendar to choose when Auto Towers may run, while troop availability and other limits still apply.

save_changes.label: Save changes
save_changes.description: Select Save changes to apply your settings; reading this guide does not save them.

auto_towers_switch.label: Auto Towers switch
auto_towers_switch.description: Turn on Auto Towers on the Automation page after saving your settings to allow the task to run.
auto_towers_switch.recommendation: On after saving your intended settings.

feature.name: Auto Towers
feature.description: Sends attacks against robber-baron and kingdom towers from the castles you choose.
feature.expectation: It needs enough troops, an available commander and a tower that is ready to attack. It may wait while troops return or a tower's timer runs down.

autoBird.recommendationIntro: Recommended values describe regular Auto Bird use; they are guidance and do not change saved settings.

open_settings.label: Open settings
open_settings.description: At the top of the command center, select the settings button beside Auto Bird.

general.title: Set stationing time and sending rules

random_delay_range_min.label: Random delay range · Min
random_delay_range_min.description: Set the shortest number of hours troops will stay at the alliance destination after travel completes.
random_delay_range_min.recommendation: 6 hours stationed at the alliance target after arrival.

random_delay_range_max.label: Random delay range · Max
random_delay_range_max.description: Set the longest stay at the destination; Auto Bird chooses a random duration between Min and Max.
random_delay_range_max.recommendation: 12 hours stationed at the alliance target after arrival.

minimum_to_send.label: Minimum to send
minimum_to_send.description: Set the minimum total number of eligible troops needed after castle reserves are kept; this is a threshold, not the exact number sent.
minimum_to_send.recommendation: 1,000 eligible troops in total after castle reserves are kept; this is a threshold, not an exact send size.

minimum_rpt_remaining_protection_time.label: Minimum RPT (remaining protection time)
minimum_rpt_remaining_protection_time.description: Use targets with more than this many days of protection remaining; 0 removes the check.
minimum_rpt_remaining_protection_time.recommendation: 3 days; a target must have more than 3 days of remaining protection time.

image.alt: Auto Bird stationing delay, minimum send, minimum RPT, and preset controls
image.caption: Set stationing time and eligibility, then review the Everyday reserve preset before saving.

reserves.title: Choose troops to keep in each castle

add_unit.label: Add unit
add_unit.description: For each castle, choose troop types to keep at home instead of sending; an empty reserve leaves all eligible troops available after automatic reserves.
add_unit.recommendation: Choose the troop types each castle needs for defense or other regular jobs.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.description: Set a positive quantity of each chosen troop to keep in that castle; 0 does not reserve the whole type.
quantity.recommendation: Keep the number of each troop type this castle needs at home for defense or other jobs; review actual troop counts.

remove_unit.label: Remove unit
remove_unit.description: Remove a unit tile to stop reserving that type in the selected castle.

auto_fortress_reserve.label: Auto Fortress reserve
auto_fortress_reserve.description: When Auto Fortress locks all Direwolves here, this automatic reserve is not saved in Auto Bird presets and any earlier manual Direwolf amount returns when the lock ends.

image.alt: Auto Bird castle reserve tiles for fictional Example Castle
image.caption: Reserve only the units needed at this castle; Unit 101 and Unit 102 are fictional troop placeholders.

preset_name.label: Preset name
preset_name.description: Enter a name for a new preset or edit the applied preset’s name before saving changes.
preset_name.recommendation: Use a recognizable name such as Everyday.

load_preset.label: Load preset
load_preset.description: Choose a saved preset in the list, or choose Saved configuration to use the stored settings without a named preset.
load_preset.recommendation: Use the intended everyday preset as the runtime default: select it, Apply, then Save changes.

apply.label: Apply
apply.description: Load the selected preset into this settings draft; select Save changes to commit it as the runtime default.

save_as_new.label: Save as new
save_as_new.description: Immediately save the current settings as a new named preset and select it as the runtime default.

delete.label: Delete
delete.description: After confirmation, immediately delete the selected preset and clear the runtime default if it was selected.

runtime_default.label: Runtime default
runtime_default.description: The runtime default is the saved active preset, or the saved configuration when no preset is active.

finish.title: Set the schedule, save and enable

calendar.label: Calendar
calendar.description: Choose when Auto Bird may run and select Save Schedule for your changes.
calendar.recommendation: Leave the schedule off for ongoing operation, or set usual weekly hours and Save Schedule.

specify_preset_per_period.label: Specify Preset Per Period
specify_preset_per_period.description: Choose a saved preset for a calendar period when that period should override the runtime default.
specify_preset_per_period.recommendation: Off unless different periods need different reserves.

save_changes.label: Save changes
save_changes.description: Save the settings draft and any applied preset changes; reading this guide does not save them.

auto_bird_switch.label: Auto Bird switch
auto_bird_switch.description: Turn on Auto Bird at the top of the command center after saving to allow its normal castle cycles.
auto_bird_switch.recommendation: Turn Auto Bird on after saving; the header status shows each castle’s cycle.

feature.name: Auto Bird
feature.summary: Keep selected troops away on a schedule
feature.description: Routinely stations spare troops at eligible alliance castles and repeats the cycle when they return.
feature.expectation: It waits if there is no suitable destination or no spare troops to send. Moving troops does not make your castle invulnerable.

birdGeneral.title: General settings
birdGeneral.send: Minimum eligible total after reserves: 1,000 troops
birdGeneral.rpt: Minimum protection remaining: more than 3 days
